papers.title: Stage-Resolved Evolution of Lithium-Metal Anodes: Origins of Cycle-Life Gains and Losses
papers.abstract_en: Lithium-metal electrodes offer high specific capacities, but their long-term durability is governed by complex morphological and interfacial evolution that is difficult to resolve from cycle-life metrics and discrete characterization alone....
papers.summary_ko: 리튬 금속 전극은 높은 비용량을 제공하지만 장기 내구성은 복잡한 형태학적·계면 변화에 의해 좌우되며, 이는 전체 사이클 수명 지표나 개별 분석만으로는 규명하기 어렵다. 이 연구는 단계별(stage-resolved) 분석을 통해 사이클 수명 향상과 저하를 가져오는 근본 원인을 규명한다.

papers.title: Unlocking cycle life of lithium-metal batteries
papers.summary_ko: 리튬 금속 전지의 사이클 수명을 개선하는 방안을 다루는 연구로 보인다. (제목 기반 추정)

papers.title: Tailored Functional Group Design in In‐Situ Polymerized Gel Electrolytes for High‐Voltage, Wide‐Temperature, and Safe Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT The demand for ultrahigh‐energy‐density storage has reinvigorated lithium metal batteries (LMBs), yet their practical deployment is hampered by flammable liquid electrolytes and detrimental interfacial reactivity. In situ polymerized gel polymer electrolytes (GPEs) present a compelling transitional solution by combining the mechanical robustness of solids with the ionic conductivity of liquids. Despite these advantages, current in situ GPEs grapple with a fundamental trilemma of ionic conductivity, electrochemical stability, and interfacial compatibility, which collectively limit their high‐voltage tolerance, wide‐temperature operability, and intrinsic safety. To overcome these bottlenecks, molecular‐level functional‐group design is crucial. This review systematically analyzes recent advances in functional‐group engineering for in situ GPEs. First, it establishes theoretical frameworks from five dimensions: Lewis acid‐base, frontier molecular orbital, hard‐soft acid‐base, dipole interactions, and steric effects. Subsequently, it thoroughly analyzes key functional group mechanisms across three performance dimensions: high‐voltage stability, wide‐temperature performance, and intrinsic safety. Finally, it outlines prevailing challenges and future directions, aiming to consolidate a theoretical foundation and provide practical guidelines for developing high‐energy‐density, intrinsically safe LMBs.
papers.summary_ko: 고전압, 광온도 범위, 안전성을 갖춘 리튬 금속 전지(LMB)를 위한 in-situ 중합형 젤 고분자 전해질(GPE)의 작용기 설계 전략을 체계적으로 분석한 리뷰이다. 루이스 산-염기, 프런티어 분자궤도, HSAB, 쌍극자 상호작용, 입체 효과 등 다섯 가지 이론적 틀을 바탕으로 작용기가 고전압 안정성, 광온도 성능, 계면 반응성(내재적 안전성)에 미치는 메커니즘을 정리하고 향후 방향을 제시한다.

papers.title: Secondary Solvation Shell Regulation for Fast-Charging Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Most electrolyte strategies in lithium metal batteries (LMBs) target the first solvation shell or solvation diversity. However, such approaches have shown limited success in enabling fast-charging, as Li+ depletion inevitably develops at polarized interfaces. Here, we identify the secondary solvation shell as a critical regulator of fast-charging stability and show that a gradient solvation structure (GSS) overcomes ion depletion-induced failure. Guided by intrinsic solvation strengths, we design a tri-solvent electrolyte comprising 1,2-dimethoxyethane (DME), 1,1,1-trifluoro-2,3-dimethoxypropane (TFDMP), and N,N-dimethyltrifluoromethane-sulfonamide (DMTMSA). DME and TFDMP define a stable primary solvation shell and balanced ion-pair distribution, whereas DMTMSA localizes in the secondary shell, suppressing long-range ionic clustering and maintaining interfacial ion availability. Despite similar primary-shell structures and equilibrium impedances, only the tri-solvent system preserves interfacial kinetics under depletion conditions. This architecture enables a Coulombic efficiency of 98.4% at 16 mA cm–2, a specific capacity of 162.0 mAh g–1 at 10C, and 90.4% capacity retention for 200 cycles. These findings establish a gradient solvation structure as a governing principle for fast-charging LMB electrolytes.
papers.summary_ko: 대부분의 전해질 전략이 1차 솔베이션 셸 조절에 집중하는 것과 달리, 이 연구는 2차 솔베이션 셸이 고속 충전 안정성을 좌우하는 핵심 요인임을 규명한다. DME, TFDMP, DMTMSA 삼원 용매로 구성된 구배 솔베이션 구조(GSS)를 설계해 2차 셸에서 장거리 이온 클러스터링을 억제하고 계면 이온 가용성을 유지함으로써, 고속 충전 리튬 금속 전지에서 98.4%의 쿨롱 효율과 10C에서 162.0 mAh/g의 용량, 200사이클 후 90.4%의 용량 유지율을 달성했다.

papers.title: Reconfiguring Interfacial Electrochemical Potential for Boosting Sodium‐Ion Transport in Composite Solid Electrolytes
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Sluggish ion transport kinetics between the ceramic and polymer phases remain a key challenge in composite solid electrolytes (CSEs), primarily due to a severe interfacial barrier arising from their intrinsic physicochemical incompatibility. Herein, molecular design‐enabled electronic structure engineering is proposed to reconfigure the interfacial electrochemical environment at the Na 3 Zr 2 Si 2 PO 12 –poly(ethylene oxide) interface, based on a dual‐axis screening guided by the electron‐donating capability and molecular electronic asymmetry. By grafting different functional trimethoxysilanes from a targeted library onto the ceramic surface, the effect of the interfacial electrochemical potential on Na‐ion transport is investigated, revealing a strong negative correlation with the ionic conductivity of CSEs. The CSE with the optimal grafting molecule (phenyltrimethoxysilane) reduces the potential mismatch by 87% and lowers the Na‐ion migration barrier, thereby boosting Na‐ion conductivity by two orders of magnitude. All‐solid‐state sodium‐metal batteries using this CSE show boosted electrochemical performance with a high capacity of 91.8 mAh g −1 delivered at 5 C and retain ∼99% of their initial capacity after 500 cycles at 2 C. This work establishes a screening framework for reducing interfacial potential mismatch and addressing the long‐standing ion‐transport bottleneck across ceramic–polymer interfaces in CSEs.
papers.summary_ko: 세라믹-고분자 복합 고체전해질(CSE)에서 계면 전기화학적 포텐셜을 분자 설계로 재구성하여 Na+ 이동을 저해하는 계면 장벽을 완화하는 전략을 제시한다. 작용기별 실란 그래프팅을 통해 포텐셜 불일치와 이온전도도 간 강한 음의 상관관계를 규명했고, 최적 조성에서 포텐셜 불일치를 87% 줄이고 이온전도도를 두 자릿수 향상시켰다.

papers.title: Highly conductive halide Na-ion conductor enabled by cost-effective aliovalent carbonate polyanion substitution for all-solid-state sodium batteries
papers.abstract_en: Halide-based Na-ion conductors have attracted intense attention due to their favorable (electro)chemical compatibility with oxide positive electrodes. Among these, zirconium (Zr)-based halide solid electrolytes (SEs) offer a cost advantage over halide SEs based on rare metals, but the relatively low ionic conductivity has limited their application in all-solid-state batteries (ASSBs). Here, we report employing soda ash (Na2CO3) as a low-cost precursor to introduce an aliovalent carbonate polyanion and produce a family of Na-Zr-Cl-CO3 conductors with nominal compositions of (2-x)NaCl-xNa2CO3-ZrCl4. This substitution increases structural disorder and amorphization, creating structural environments that facilitate Na+ transport. At the optimal composition, its ionic conductivity reaches 1.02 mS cm−1 at 25 °C. The optimized Na-Zr-Cl-CO3 SE also exhibits stable electrochemical behavior and favorable mechanical properties. When paired with NaCrO2 positive electrode, the assembled ASSBs deliver an initial discharge capacity of 117 mAh g−1 at 0.1 C and demonstrate a long-term cycling stability at 0.3 C for 850 cycles. This work highlights carbonate polyanion substitution as a practical strategy for improving low-cost Zr-based halide SEs, offering a promising route toward ASSBs with high performance. Zr-based halide solid electrolytes are promising for their lower cost but suffer from limited ionic conductivity. Here, authors introduce carbonate polyanion using cost-competitive soda ash to enhance structural disorder and Na+ transport, achieving 1.02 mS cm−1 ionic conductivity and stable all-solid-state battery cycling for 850 cycles.
papers.summary_ko: 저가의 소다애시를 전구체로 활용해 할라이드계 Na-Zr-Cl-CO3 고체전해질에 탄산염 폴리아니온을 치환 도입함으로써 구조적 무질서도를 높여 Na+ 전도도를 향상시킨 연구이다. 최적 조성에서 25°C 이온전도도 1.02 mS/cm를 달성했고, NaCrO2 양극과 결합한 전고체전지에서 850회 장기 안정성을 보였다.

papers.title: Engineering Amino‐Induced p‐π Conjugation for Electronic Regulation of Li + Transport in PVDF‐Based Solid‐State Electrolytes
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Sluggish Li + transport in poly(vinylidene fluoride) (PVDF)‐based solid polymer electrolytes (SPEs) arises from restricted polymer segmental motion and persistent Li + ‐FSI − association, while conventional fillers provide limited regulation of the local electronic and coordination environments. Herein, amino‐functionalized UiO66‐NH 2 is introduced into a PVDF/lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide (LiFSI) electrolyte to construct electronically active composite SPEs (U6NP). The electron‐donating ─NH 2 groups induce p‐π conjugation, redistribute the linker electron density, and strengthen ligand‐to‐metal charge transfer (LMCT)‐related electronic coupling between the organic linkers and Zr‐O clusters. This electronic reconstruction, together with amino‐associated modulation of local O‐centered coordination environments, reshapes the electrostatic landscape, weakens Li + ‐FSI − interactions, and facilitates Li + migration. U6NP delivers a room‐temperature ionic conductivity of 2.41 × 10 −3 S cm −1 , a Li + transference number of 0.56, and an oxidative stability of 4.42 V. More importantly, Li||U6NP||LiNi 0.8 Co 0.1 Mn 0.1 O 2 (NCM811) cells with a cathode loading of 21.5 mg cm −2 retain 98.51% after 120 cycles at 0.05 C. The Li||U6NP||NCM811 pouch cell delivers 136.6 mAh g −1 initially and 120.9 mAh g −1 after 100 cycles. This work establishes ─NH 2 ‐induced p‐π conjugation‐enhanced LMCT as an effective strategy for electronically active MOF‐reinforced PVDF electrolytes toward high‐loading solid‐state lithium metal batteries.
papers.summary_ko: PVDF 기반 고체 고분자 전해질에 아미노 기능화된 UiO66-NH2를 도입하여 p-π 공액과 리간드-금속 전하이동을 통해 Li+-FSI- 상호작용을 약화시키고 Li+ 이동을 촉진하는 전자적 조절 전략을 제시한다. 이를 통해 실온 이온전도도 2.41×10^-3 S/cm, Li+ 전달율 0.56을 달성했고, 고로딩 NCM811 양극과의 셀에서 120사이클 후 98.51%의 용량 유지율을 보였다.

papers.title: Achieving Stable Sodium Storage in Sodium Superionic Conductor Anodes via Iron-Enabled Bulk-Interface Confinement for Aqueous Batteries
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Sodium titanium phosphate (NaTi2(PO4)3, NTP), a promising sodium superionic conductor (NASICON)-type anode for aqueous sodium-ion batteries, suffers from severe capacity fade in alkaline electrolytes due to dissolution of Ti via soluble titanate formation. Herein, we introduce an iron-doping-enabled dual-scale confinement strategy that delivers high capacity and exceptional stability. Iron incorporation in NTP induces a solubility limited behavior: a fraction of Fe enters the NASICON lattice, while excess Fe migrates toward the surface to form a partially amorphous Fe3O4 shell, creating cooperative bulk-shell architecture. The iron-rich outer layer, populated with redox-active Fe3+/Fe2+ couples, acts as a barrier that intercepts and consumes inward-diffusing OH– ions, while inner Fe3+/Fe2+ redox reactions competitively consume residual OH– within the lattice, thereby effectively suppressing soluble titanate formation. This study confirms a synergistic self-protecting and capacity-enhancing mechanism for NTP-based anode design. Consequently, the as-prepared anode delivers a high specific capacity of 164.9 mAh g–1 among all reported NTP anodes, while retaining 90.9% of its initial capacity after 2000 cycles, significantly outperforming previous benchmarks. Paired with a Ni–Co layered double hydroxide cathode, the full cell delivers a high energy density of 106.4 Wh kg–1. This self-organized core–shell dual-defense architecture provides a broadly applicable strategy for stabilizing electrodes in corrosive environments.
papers.summary_ko: 수계 소듐이온전지용 NASICON형 NaTi2(PO4)3(NTP) 음극이 알칼리 전해질에서 겪는 티타네이트 용해 문제를 해결하기 위해 철 도핑 기반 벌크-계면 이중 보호 전략을 제시한다. 철이 격자 내부와 표면 Fe3O4 쉘 양쪽에 분포해 OH- 유입을 차단함으로써 용해를 억제했고, 164.9 mAh/g의 비용량과 2000사이클 후 90.9%의 용량 유지율을 달성했다.

papers.title: Thermodynamically Controlled Multiphase Evolution in Single‐Crystal Cation‐Disordered Li‐Ion Cathode Materials
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Mn‐based disordered rock‐salt (Mn‐DRX) cathodes are promising materials for Li‐ion batteries, yet their application is limited by sluggish Li transport, voltage instability, and capacity fading. Here, we show that thermodynamic control of multiphase evolution from single‐crystal Mn‐DRX overcomes these limitations. Using grand‐potential phase diagrams with in situ and ex situ X‐ray diffraction and transmission electron microscopy, we demonstrate that DRX composition and annealing conditions govern transformation into nanocomposites containing DRX, spinel, and monoclinic layered phases, with anatase formation predicted in specific Li–Mn–Ti–O compositions. Oxidative annealing at 300–500°C induces decomposition pathways: Li‐deficient compositions form DRX–spinel (DS) nanocomposites, whereas Li‐rich compositions form DRX–spinel–monoclinic layered (DSM) architectures. Unlike DS materials, which exhibit lower first‐charge capacities than discharge capacities, the monoclinic phase in DSM nanocomposites enables substantially improved first‐charge Li extraction, critical for practical Li‐ion batteries. The DSM nanocomposites deliver reversible capacities approaching 300 mAh g −1 and discharge specific energies exceeding 800 Wh kg −1 , while their cycling stability can be substantially improved by using a highly concentrated electrolyte and restricting the voltage window. This work establishes thermodynamically guided multiphase engineering as a strategy for addressing transport and stability limitations in DRX cathodes.
papers.summary_ko: Mn 기반 양이온 무질서 암염형(DRX) 리튬이온 양극 소재의 다상 전이를 열역학적으로 제어하여 전하용량과 전압 안정성 한계를 극복하는 연구이다. 산화 어닐링 조건과 Li 함량에 따라 DRX-스피넬 또는 DRX-스피넬-단사정 층상구조로 분해되는 경로를 규명했으며, 단사정 층상상을 포함한 나노복합체(DSM)가 첫 충전 시 Li 추출 특성을 크게 개선하여 300 mAh/g에 근접하는 가역 용량을 보였다.

papers.title: Multiscale Characterizations Toward Energy Storage Carbon Materials From Precursors to Electrodes
papers.abstract_en: -hybridized carbon materials such as graphite, soft carbon, and hard carbon, are broadly used as anodes for alkali-metal-ion batteries owing to their stable and controllable microstructures. However, the inherent structural complexity and multi-stage synthesis processes of carbon materials pose challenges to their comprehensive characterization, limiting a deeper structural understanding and performance improvement of carbon electrodes. This review establishes a comprehensive characterization framework for the multiscale understanding of carbon materials from their precursors to carbon electrodes. Because the structural features of carbon materials are largely inherited from their precursors, we first summarize the recent advances in the characterization of their molecular structures and pyrolysis behaviors. We then discuss advanced characterization techniques and corresponding analysis methods used to understand the multiscale structures of carbon materials, including particles, microcrystals, and pore structures. We further provide a comprehensive overview of static and real time characterization techniques for studying interfacial ion transport and bulk ion diffusion kinetics in carbon electrodes. On this basis, we draw a decision-making framework for multiscale characterization to help readers quickly navigate from problem definition to characterization strategy. Finally, we provide future perspectives to facilitate the efficient scientific investigation and rational design of high-performance carbon materials for alkali-metal-ion batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 알칼리금속이온전지 음극으로 널리 쓰이는 흑연, 소프트카본, 하드카본 등 탄소 소재를 전구체부터 전극까지 다중 스케일로 특성 분석하는 프레임워크를 제시하는 리뷰 논문이다. 분자 구조, 열분해 거동, 미세결정·기공 구조, 이온 전달 거동을 다루는 분석 기법들을 체계적으로 정리하고, 문제 정의부터 분석 전략 선택까지 돕는 의사결정 프레임워크를 제공한다.

papers.title: MEC‐BioSense: Material‐Encoded Capillary Biointerface for Autonomous Whole‐Blood Biomarker Sensing
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Bioelectronic sensing in complex biological fluids is often constrained not by molecular recognition, but by poor coordination of transport, separation, and interfacial interactions at the material level. Here, we present a material‐encoded capillary biointerface that integrates microporous media, microfluidic geometry, and a hydrophilic graphene/poly(3,4‐ethylenedioxythiophene):poly(styrenesulfonate)/Prussian Blue bioelectronic interface into a unified, self‐regulated architecture. Capillary forces generated within a microfiber network are redistributed through vent‐regulated pathways and stabilized at a hydrophilic mixed ionic–electronic interface, enabling controlled plasma extraction, transport, and analyte delivery without external actuation. System performance is governed by the balance between capillary driving pressure and distributed hydrodynamic resistance, defining an operating regime that simultaneously achieves >99% cellular exclusion, ∼80–93% protein recovery, and stable interfacial wetting. Within this regime, undiluted whole blood is autonomously converted into a reproducible electrochemical signal. Using glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP) as a model biomarker, the platform enables direct sample‐to‐answer detection within ∼9 min, spanning 0.02 pg mL −1 to 200 ng mL −1 with an ultralow detection limit (∼0.01 fg mL −1 ) and reduced pre‐analytical loss relative to centrifugation. These results establish that analytical performance is governed primarily by pre‐analytical transport and interfacial regulation and introduce a generalizable nano/micro‐engineered framework for autonomous, scalable point‐of‐care biointerfaces.
papers.summary_ko: 전혈에서 생체표지자를 자율적으로 검출하는 모세관 기반 바이오인터페이스 플랫폼에 관한 연구로, 배터리 소재와는 무관한 생체전자 센싱 기술이다. 그래핀/PEDOT:PSS/프러시안 블루 계면을 이용해 혈장 분리와 전달을 외부 구동 없이 수행하며, GFAP 바이오마커를 약 9분 내 검출할 수 있음을 보였다.

papers.title: Layered Centrosymmetric Copper(II) Coordination Polymer Enabling Four‐Electron Redox Reaction for High‐Performance Sodium‐Ion Battery Cathode
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Conductive copper‐based metal‐organic polymers are attractive cathodes for sodium‐ion batteries (SIBs), yet their application is limited by slow Na + diffusion, active material dissolution, and poor cycling stability. Herein, a layered centrosymmetric Cu‐DDAQ material (DDAQ = 1,5‐diamino‐4,8‐dihydroxyanthraquinone) with an extended π‐d conjugated coordination network is reported as a high‐capacity and structurally stable SIB cathode. The interlayered π‐d conjugated Cu–O 3 N units serve as dual redox centers (Cu 2+ /Cu + and C═O/C–O redox couples), lifting sodium storage capacity, strengthening structure, and suppressing electrolyte‐induced dissolution. The well‐defined π‐d conjugated Cu–O 3 N moieties accelerate charge transfer and fast Na + diffusion, affording high electronic conductivity and favorable reaction kinetics. Cu‐DDAQ delivers a high reversible specific capacity of 270 mAh g − 1 at 0.02 A g − 1 , and maintains a high capacity retention of 77% after 850 cycles at 1.0 A g − 1 , outperforming most reported mainstream organic electrode materials for SIBs. The assembled full cell paired with NaBiIn‐Na metal anode also achieves stable long‐cycle performance, demonstrating its great application potential in low‐cost and high‐performance SIBs. This work presents a rational and universal structural modulation strategy for designing and fabricating high‐stability, high‐capacity conjugated metal‐organic polymer electrode materials, paving a new avenue for the development of advanced, low‐cost SIB energy storage.
papers.summary_ko: Cu-DDAQ라는 층상 중심대칭 구리(II) 배위고분자를 소듐이온전지(SIB) 양극 소재로 제시한다. π-d 공액 Cu-O3N 유닛이 Cu2+/Cu+와 C=O/C-O의 이중 레독스 중심으로 작용해 용량과 구조 안정성을 높였으며, 270 mAh/g의 가역 용량과 850회 사이클 후 77%의 용량 유지율을 달성했다.
